# pbs_notification_matcher (Resource)

Manages a notification matcher.

Notification matchers define rules for routing notification events to specific targets or endpoints. 
They can filter notifications based on severity, custom fields, and calendar schedules. This allows 
for sophisticated notification routing, such as sending critical errors to on-call staff or filtering 
informational messages to specific channels.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name identifier for the notification matcher.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment describing this notification matcher.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this notification matcher. Defaults to `false`.
- `invert_match` (Boolean) Invert the matching logic (route notifications that DON'T match the criteria). Defaults to `false`.
- `match_calendar` (List of String) List of calendar IDs to match for time-based routing (requires calendar configuration in PBS).
- `match_field` (List of String) List of `field=value` pairs to match against notification metadata (e.g., `type=prune`, `hostname=server01`).
- `match_severity` (List of String) List of severity levels to match. Valid values: `info`, `notice`, `warning`, `error`.
- `mode` (String) Match mode: `all` (all conditions must match) or `any` (at least one condition must match). Defaults to `all`.
- `targets` (List of String) List of notification target or endpoint names to route matching notifications to.

### Read-Only

- `origin` (String) Origin of this configuration as reported by PBS (e.g., `user`, `builtin`).
